name: minecraft-server
description: Servidor Minecraft Java + Bedrock com Paper e GeyserMC

scripts.dev:tunnel: concurrently -n SERVER,WEB,TUNNEL -c green,cyan,magenta "node start-server.js" "node web-server.js" "bash start-tunnel.sh"
